hints.title: Simulation Tracking
hints.text: Every 'E' represents an entry requiring a chair, while 'L' represents leaving and freeing a chair.

hints.title: Simultaneous Peak
hints.text: Track the current number of people in the room at each step.

hints.title: Running Maximum
hints.text: The minimum number of chairs required is the peak simultaneous count.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single pass is optimal.
